items.title: Bring Your Squad Back From the Brink
items.body: All hope is not lost when a teammate goes down! When they fall, they leave behind a Reboot Card. Pick it up, take it to a Reboot Van, and bring them back into the fight for a better shot at victory.

items.title: Rarer Color, Better Weapons!
items.body: Weapons come in five rarities: Gray (Common), Green (Uncommon), Blue (Rare), Purple (Epic), and Orange (Legendary). Higher rarity means better stats, so open Chests and swap out weapons when finding something better!

items.title: A$AP Rocky Sails In
items.body: A new Captain has taken over part of the Island! Face the A$AP Rocky Boss to earn Lil' Flacko, and blast away the competition with the A$AP Rocky's Shock Rocket.

items.title: The Slender Man Outfit
items.body: From the darkness, a blank face watches. Suit up as the internet legend in The Slender Man Outfit.
